steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Now... Let the Chosen One's grand adventure begin! Which <color=#fb9259>ally<color=#7683a2> will you meet first...<color=#7683a2>
The girl has just finished her cheesy line when a small ice storm formed not far from you. The storm sweeps up icicles and rocks, blasting in your direction furiously.
The storm gains powerful velocity in mere seconds. Several shattered icy rocks dart at you at a speed inestimable by the bare eye.
This must be the Game Master's warm welcome for you. If you guess right, what comes next should be...
Get out of here!
A shadow emerges from the storm. With a white flash, the icy rocks flying at you are crushed in the blink of an eye.
The shadow halts. A pink-haired swordswoman appears before you, her whole body covered in ice and frost, melting in the hot steam.
The game can't go on if you die. She must be the NPC whose job is to save your life... The Chosen One's ally?
Seeing your stunned face, the swordswoman hammered your head once with the hilt of her sword.

steps.speaker: Swordswoman
steps.content: This is no wandering ground for a novice adventurer like you.
Your head hurts quite a bit. She's your savior in the first chapter of the game. Perhaps she's mad because you didn't say thank you...

steps.speaker: Swordswoman
steps.content: What rotten luck...
As you think that, the dark-purple ice storm is already right next to you. The young swordswoman shakes her head and knocks you down with the hilt.
The whole world blurs. It's the familiar dizziness again... If the first hit was for your impoliteness, then what was the second one for?!
(Scene change)
When you awake, you smell a hint of roast meat aroma. The swordswoman squats not far from you, staring at you intently.
Though you already know she means no harm, you somehow get the feeling that the Game Master is secretly enjoying that part of the plot where you got knocked out.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why did you knock me out?

steps.speaker: Swordswoman
steps.content: Well... The situation called for it.
An awkward smile emerging on her face, the girl clarifies it to you urgently. You've only blacked out for a while, but her attitude seems to have taken a 180.

steps.speaker: Swordswoman
steps.content: We had to leave immediately, and I noticed that you were lost in thought. So... I... piggybacked you out of there. Oh, by the way, my name is Tetya, and I am honored to serve you, <color=#fb9259>the Chosen One</color>.
The Chosen One again... Is this some kinda trope in this world?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What does the Chosen One actually mean?

steps.content: The swordswoman opened her rucksack and passed the white dice inside to you reverently.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: Here. This thing you were carrying, this is the <color=#fb9259>Fate Dice</color> in the legends.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: "When the Chosen One descends from outside the sky, the Fate Dice will guide the world to its redemption."
The swordswoman stares at you intently with almost religious anticipation and reverence.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: My lord, from now on, I'll protect you and follow you until the world finds salvation.
Watching the NPC's sincere face and the snow-covered wreckage left by the disaster behind her, you can't help but lapse into silence.
